Title: Register account
Description / user story: As a student, I can register so my study material is personal.
Checklist: Build registration form; implement validation and persistence; verify valid and invalid cases.
Acceptance criteria: Valid registration succeeds; duplicate email and short password fail; only a BCrypt hash is stored.

Title: Log in
Description / user story: As a student, I can log in so I can access my records.
Checklist: Build login form; configure sessions and CSRF; verify login and protected routes.
Acceptance criteria: Valid credentials start a session; invalid credentials fail; protected API rejects anonymous requests.

Title: Log out
Description / user story: As a student, I can log out so this browser no longer accesses my account.
Checklist: Add logout action; invalidate session; verify access after logout.
Acceptance criteria: Logout invalidates the session; protected requests fail afterward; UI returns to login.

Title: Create note
Description / user story: As a student, I can save a note so my study content stays together.
Checklist: Build note form; implement owned create endpoint; verify validation and persistence.
Acceptance criteria: Valid title/body persist under current user; empty/oversize input fails; note remains after restart.

Title: List and read notes
Description / user story: As a student, I can browse my notes so I can find material to study.
Checklist: Build note list/detail; add owner-filtered queries; verify using two accounts.
Acceptance criteria: List and detail show only current user notes; empty state works; cross-user detail returns 404.

Title: Edit and delete notes
Description / user story: As a student, I can maintain my notes so outdated content can be corrected.
Checklist: Add edit/delete UI and API; enforce dependency rule; verify both owners.
Acceptance criteria: Edits persist; confirmation precedes delete; delete is blocked with linked reviewers; cross-user writes fail.

Title: Manage reviewer
Description / user story: As a student, I can write or paste a reviewer so I have a concise study guide.
Checklist: Build reviewer form; implement CRUD and note link; verify ownership and delete restriction.
Acceptance criteria: Create/edit/delete owned reviewer works; source note is required; deletion with quizzes is blocked.

Title: Browse and read reviewers
Description / user story: As a student, I can open my reviewers so I can review a topic.
Checklist: Build list/detail; link source note; verify empty state and ownership.
Acceptance criteria: Owned reviewer list and detail render plain text; source note is linked; other users cannot read it.

Title: Manage multiple-choice quiz
Description / user story: As a student, I can prepare practice questions so I can test my understanding.
Checklist: Build quiz form; implement transactional save and validation; verify edit/delete restrictions.
Acceptance criteria: Accept 1–20 questions with four choices and one key; reject invalid questions; lock questions after first attempt; block deletion with attempts.

Title: Take quiz
Description / user story: As a student, I can answer a quiz so I can practice recalling the topic.
Checklist: Build taking screen; obtain token; submit selected answers; verify duplicate submission handling.
Acceptance criteria: Take endpoint omits keys; selection and unanswered items work; submit once with token; navigate to saved result.

Title: Grade and display result
Description / user story: As a student, I can see my score and correct answers so I know what to review.
Checklist: Implement grading and token uniqueness; save attempt/answers; build result view; check known scores.
Acceptance criteria: Server grades correctly; unanswered items are wrong; one transaction saves score and answers; result shows correct choices after submission only.

Title: View attempt history
Description / user story: As a student, I can revisit attempts so I can compare practice results.
Checklist: Build history and result links; query owned attempts; verify persistence and two-account isolation.
Acceptance criteria: Newest attempts show quiz/date/score; results reopen after login; cross-user attempts cannot be read.
